svg.title: Read the Clock Behind the Commission
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-program-duration-checkpoints; chapter number: 2; title: Read the Clock Behind the Commission; subtitle: Attribution windows, withdrawal timing, and recurring commission duration are different terms.; caption: Kris the Entrepreneur describes cookie windows; Khris Steven describes withdrawal timing; Adam Enfroy checks recurring commission cutoffs.; assumptions note: Kris the Entrepreneur, Khris Steven, and Adam Enfroy provide examples rather than a market-wide timing distribution. Units remain explicit on each bar. The typical field uses a reported value or range endpoint, not an estimated average.; note: Khris Steven's two-to-five-business-day withdrawal statement is not a cookie window. Adam Enfroy's twelve-month cutoff check is not a promise of lifetime commissions.; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: Reported duration; days, business days, or months as labeled; bars: label: Short cookie example; min: 7; max: 7; typical: 7; display: 7 days — Kris the Entrepreneur; label: Monthly cookie example; min: 30; max: 30; typical: 30; display: 30 days — Kris the Entrepreneur; label: Extended cookie example; min: 90; max: 90; typical: 90; display: 90 days — Kris the Entrepreneur; label: Withdrawal deposit estimate; min: 2; max: 5; typical: 2; display: 2–5 business days — Khris Steven; label: Recurring cutoff to inspect; min: 12; max: 12; typical: 12; display: 12 months — Adam Enfroy checks beyond this cutoff
